samples.question: The image shows one closed black loop (a ring) on a white background and a thick red thread that starts at a green dot and ends at a blue dot. The thread is an open curve: it begins at the green dot, travels across the picture, and stops at the blue dot. The thread CROSSES the black loop each time it passes from the inside of the loop to the outside (or from the outside to the inside). A crossing happens exactly where the red thread overlaps the black ring. How many times does the red thread cross the black loop? Count each passage through the ring as one crossing. Answer with a single number from 0, 1, 2, or 3.
